insight: On macOS, uv-installed editable packages (uv pip install -e . or uv sync) can produce .pth files with the BSD UF_HIDDEN flag set (visible via ls -lO showing hidden attribute, traced to com.apple.provenance xattr). Python 3.12 site.addpackage() explicitly skips hidden .pth files (cpython site.py:178), so editable installs silently fail to add their src path to sys.path. Symptom: ModuleNotFoundError despite a present .pth pointing at the right path. Fix: chflags nohidden /path/to/site-packages/*.pth. Recurs on every uv reinstall. Diagnosis: ls -lO <pth> shows hidden flag, stat -f %Sf shows hidden in flags. This bit us during Try-DesignSystem branch dev:full bring-up.

This repo has NO VERSION file — version lives only in package.json + frontend/package.json (per CLAUDE.md). gstack-version-bump classify reports DRIFT_UNEXPECTED (baseVersion 0.0.0.0 from missing VERSION file); ignore it and verify manually against develop:package.json instead.

Basaev demo design = Quiet Gravity: near-white grey radial canvas (#f7f7f5->#e7e7e4, lighter top-right), Archivo Expanded Black giant BASAEV wordmark w/ one-time light sweep, SF Pro (-apple-system) for all UI, liquid glass as the single material (white 15-42% + hairline dark edge + inset highlight + elevation shadow), deep indigo accent #242a3d used sparingly. Anti-slop: no pastel/purple/mascot.
